<strong><font size="5">不必靠天分，跟着描照着画，从零学会58个素描技法（第二版）</font></strong><br>
本书专为素描零基础学习者打造，核心主张“无需天赋，只要跟着描、照着画，就能轻松掌握素描核心技能”。<br>
第二版在原版基础上优化了教学逻辑，增补了实操指导细节，让入门过程更顺畅。书中系统整理了58个实用素描技法，涵盖线条勾勒、明暗排线、透视原理、静物塑造等核心模块，每个技法都配备清晰的步骤图解和临摹模板。<br>
无论你是完全没有绘画基础的新手，还是想夯实基础的绘画爱好者，都能通过“临摹+练习”的模式，逐步攻克素描难点。<br>
无需担心没有绘画天赋，也不用纠结起步太晚，跟着书中的指引循序渐进练习，就能逐步建立素描认知，掌握从简单线条到完整作品的创作能力，轻松开启素描学习之旅。<img id="aimg_SHFmc" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.remit.ee/api/file/BQACAgUAAyEGAASHRsPbAAEN8RdpSJk4raI7AAHy183jUc2r1UGgmaIAAlonAAIvtElWoCOyDdPcxl82BA.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.remit.ee/api/file/BQACAgUAAyEGAASHRsPbAAEN8RdpSJk4raI7AAHy183jUc2r1UGgmaIAAlonAAIvtElWoCOyDdPcxl82BA.jpg"><img id="aimg_jzC56" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.remit.ee/api/file/BQACAgUAAyEGAASHRsPbAAEN8RhpSJk4POXLFc9uXf1LZPFRYqCF4wACWycAAi-0SVa9FIUm9RPNojYE.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.remit.ee/api/file/BQACAgUAAyEGAASHRsPbAAEN8RhpSJk4POXLFc9uXf1LZPFRYqCF4wACWycAAi-0SVa9FIUm9RPNojYE.jpg"><img id="aimg_uLkfC" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.remit.ee/api/file/BQACAgUAAyEGAASHRsPbAAEN8RZpSJk3iFXw-1bfPFm_y4-d1x5cPwACWScAAi-0SVbi4pN65SQ4DDYE.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.remit.ee/api/file/BQACAgUAAyEGAASHRsPbAAEN8RZpSJk3iFXw-1bfPFm_y4-d1x5cPwACWScAAi-0SVbi4pN65SQ4DDYE.jpg"></td></tr></tbody></table>
